notes: Some wind effect in open areas near the ridgetop. Nov 13 CR disappears ~2250 m. Main concerns were areas with wind effect, and the FC layer halfway down the snowpack with moderate RP to SC test results on this layer. Treeline HS ~120-140 cm.
summary: HS 120 cm, 2410 m SE (profile name SSE): hard P base 0-28 cm, 1F 28-58 cm, thin 4F FC layer 'Nov 22 FC/CR' at 58-62 cm (CT14 SC at 62 cm) under a 62-90 cm layer of 4F+ to 1F and soft F to 4F surface snow 90-120 cm; Nov 13 crust absent above ~2250 m
reading_issues: Same pit in PDF and PNG (both height-axis charts, identical readings). Header aspect is SE but profile name/filename say 'SSE Aspect'; header value recorded. Only the FC/CR layer has a grain glyph; other layers have none (grain null). Two layers (62-90 and 90-120 cm) have tapered hardness bars; hardness_idx is the layer mean, top/bottom values in comment. Hardness axis is non-uniform (F, 4F, 1F, P, K tick spacing increases); interpolated piecewise-linearly between ticks. The 'Nov 13 CR' named crust is only in the notes (absent above ~2250 m) so has null height. The CT14SC label gives no failure-layer grain; FC taken from the pink-highlighted named layer. No temperature profile drawn.
